description: This file implements the 'revert' and 'cherry-pick' built-in commands for Git, including parsing options, managing the sequence of operations, and defining the behavior for various command-line arguments and modes.

methods.name: const char * action_name(const struct replay_opts * opts)
methods.description: Determines the action name ('revert' or 'cherry-pick') based on the options.

methods.name: const char * const * revert_or_cherry_pick_usage(struct replay_opts * opts)
methods.description: Returns the usage instructions array based on the current action (revert or cherry-pick).

methods.name: int parse_opt_empty(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses the '--empty' option argument, setting the appropriate empty commit handling mode.

methods.name: int option_parse_m(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses the '-m' or '--mainline' option argument, expecting a number greater than zero.

methods.name: LAST_ARG_MUST_BE_NULL void verify_opt_compatible(const char * me,const char * base_opt,...)
methods.description: Checks for incompatible options, producing an error if conflicting options are used together.

methods.name: int run_sequencer(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct replay_opts * opts)
methods.description: Executes the main logic for running the sequence operations for revert or cherry-pick, including command-line parsing, validation, and invocation of sequence actions.

methods.name: int cmd_revert(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: The entry point for the 'git revert' command, which initializes options and calls run_sequencer.

methods.name: int cmd_cherry_pick(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: The entry point for the 'git cherry-pick' command, which initializes options and calls run_sequencer.

ctags.name: DROP_EMPTY_COMMIT
ctags.pattern: /^	DROP_EMPTY_COMMIT,         \/* skip with a notice message *\/$/

ctags.name: KEEP_EMPTY_COMMIT
ctags.pattern: /^	KEEP_EMPTY_COMMIT,         \/* keep recording as empty commits *\/$/

ctags.name: STOP_ON_EMPTY_COMMIT
ctags.pattern: /^	STOP_ON_EMPTY_COMMIT,      \/* output errors and stop in the middle of a cherry-pick *\/$/

ctags.name: cmd_cherry_pick
ctags.signature: (int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)

ctags.name: cmd_revert
ctags.signature: (int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)

ctags.name: option_parse_m
ctags.signature: (const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)

ctags.name: parse_opt_empty
ctags.pattern: /^static int parse_opt_empty(const struct option *opt, const char *arg, int unset)$/
ctags.signature: (const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)

ctags.name: run_sequencer
ctags.pattern: /^static int run_sequencer(int argc, const char **argv, const char *prefix,$/
ctags.signature: (int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct replay_opts * opts)
